headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advises Centella Mauritius Holdings on ₹4,700 crore sale of equity shares of Aster DM Quality Care
sum: Centella Mauritius Holdings Limited, a TPG-backed special purpose investment vehicle, has sold 6,24,00,000 equity shares of Aster DM Quality Care Limited (approx. 7.16% of the equity share capital of the Company) by way of share sales on…
detail: Centella Mauritius Holdings Limited, a TPG-backed special purpose investment vehicle, has sold 6,24,00,000 equity shares of Aster DM Quality Care Limited (approx. 7.16% of the equity share capital of the Company) by way of share sales on the screen-based trading of the NSE and BSE, in the block trade window, for an aggregate consideration of approximately ₹4,700 crore. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Centella Mauritius Holdings on this transaction. The transaction was led by Yash J.
